verdict.rationale: Data portability and exit are fair questions for a relay or CDN product, but the pack documents no export capability for user data. Self-hosting, open protocol support, and CMAF/HLS playback concern delivery, not exporting stored data. The S3 archiver is a user-built subscriber, which is a workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
